sources.notes: City events, added 2026-11-05. OpenCities (Granicus) site. /Visitors/City-Events is a list of program pages with no dates; the dated calendar is /City-Calendar, server-rendered cards with day, month and year spans, an address, and tags, no schema.org data and no ICS link (checked 2026-11-06). robots.txt allows /City-Calendar and /Visitors/City-Events but disallows /Train-Depot-Calendar-Events/* and a few 4th of July pages. Page 1 holds 10 cards, about 2 weeks; page 2 needs an ASP.NET postback, so only page 1 is read, and a recurring event shows only its next date. Most cards are public meetings: the itemPattern skips titles containing Meeting or Closed. Dry run on 2026-11-06: 2 events (Rake Up Caldwell, A Mix of Creativity Art, Craft and Gift Market), all-day because the list shows no time. Configured 2026-11-06 with cards mode. Terms not read
